subject: Logic
title: Reversible vs Irreversible
description: Learn Reversible vs Irreversible in one minute.

hook.text: Jeff Bezos splits decisions into two types: one-way doors you can't walk back through, and two-way doors you can.

buildup.text: Reversible decisions can be undone cheaply. Irreversible ones lock you into consequences permanently.

discovery.text: Most decisions are reversible—but we treat them as permanent, causing paralysis over trivial choices.

twist.text: Truly irreversible decisions—marriage, surgery, quitting—deserve careful analysis. Lunch orders don't.

climax.text: Match your decision effort to the decision's reversibility. Big locks need big keys.

quiz.question: Why does reversibility matter in decision-making?
options: All decisions should be treated equally
Irreversible decisions deserve more careful analysis
